_readme: Hand-entered values merged by fetch_data.py ONLY where Eurostat and the live national/international APIs return nothing (set "override": true to force). Keyed by display country code, then measure key. Use "v" for values already in the measure unit, or "local": {"value", "currency"} for prices in national currency per kWh (converted to EUR at the latest ECB monthly average from Eurostat ert_bil_eur_m). prev/y1/y5 are in the same unit as v/local.value.

electricity.note: Ofgem default tariff cap, GB average, direct debit: mean of Jul-Sep 2026 (26.11p/kWh + 57.19p/day) and Oct-Dec 2026 (26.32p/kWh + 54.83p/day), standing charge spread over 2,700 kWh/yr (Ofgem typical consumption, inside Eurostat band DC).

gas.note: Ofgem default tariff cap, GB average, direct debit, incl. 5% VAT: mean of Jul-Sep 2026 (7.33p/kWh + 29.04p/day) and Oct-Dec 2026 (7.97p/kWh + 29.68p/day), standing charge spread over 11,500 kWh/yr (inside Eurostat band D2).

electricity.note: ElCom (Swiss Federal Electricity Commission) median regulated tariff for a typical household (profile H4, 4,500 kWh/yr) for calendar year 2026: 27.7 Rp./kWh; 2025: 29.0 Rp./kWh (prev/y1, converted at the same current rate). Swiss tariffs are set per calendar year.
